object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: With read-only mode off, open the grid cell editors of VCU3-SRS-0's empty priority, req-type and verification-method cells and of its type cell, and leave each unchanged. Expected: nothing is written and the object file's bytes are unchanged. Give VCU3-SRS-2 a priority that isn't an option, open its cell editor and leave. Expected: the editor shows that value and nothing is written. Open an empty integer cell and an empty date cell and leave each untouched. Expected: nothing is written. Confirm a status cell and a description cell with the values they hold. Expected: nothing is written.
